summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace objects. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ returns a prefix test (str(ref).startswith(str(self))). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns `ref in self.__uris.values()`, so only stored term URIs match; _RDFNamespace inherits it without an override. Term resolution is unchanged. In test/test_namespace.py, added NamespaceContainsTest covering Namespace prefix membership (positive and negative), SH membership, RDFS rdfs:label (True) and rdfs:example (False), RDF rdf:type (True), and RDF _1 container property (False). Nothing was run: per instructions I only read and edited files, so the tests and doctests are unverified. No commits were made. NamespaceManager membership was not added and was not changed.
